subject: general
question: The Losar festival, quite popular in Arunachal Pradesh is mainly celebrated by the ______ tribe.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monpa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In Arunachal Pradesh, the Losar Festivals **are observed. People of the Monpa Tribe, who are thought to reside in **Arunachal Pradesh, **celebrate it.
 
• **Tawang **celebrates the three-day Losar festival with a lot of fanfare.
 
• The celebration is observed to ward off bad spirits and greet the new year, which is meant to be prosperous and happy.
 
• The state of Nagaland in North-East India is home to a sizable Naga ethnic minority known as the Angamis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Angami Nagas** are a recognised ethnic group in the state of Manipur and are primarily concentrated in the **Nagaland districts of Kohima, Chümoukedima, and Dimapur. **
 
• A group of Central Asian tribes that crossed the Khyber Pass into the Indian subcontinent towards the close of the fifth or beginning of the sixth century were known as the **Hunas by the ancient Indians.**
 
• In the** Lower Subansiri district of Arunachal Pradesh, India, in the Ziro valley, **there is a tribe known as the** Apatani.**
